metadata.title: fix: consolidate Docker workflow for reliable multiplatform builds
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Remove `docker-image.yml` which was a single-arch workflow that overwrote multiplatform images with amd64-only builds, breaking ARM64 support
- Modify `docker-multiplatform.yml` to build and push platform-specific images (amd64, arm64, s390x) only on push events
- Create `docker-scan.yml` for security scanning that builds locally without pushing:
  - Dockerfile linting with Hadolint
  - Image linting with Dockle
  - SBOM generation with Syft
  - Vulnerability scanning with Trivy and Grype
  - Runs on both PRs and pushes to catch issues early
- Add SBOM attestation via Cosign alongside image signing
- Only tag as `:latest` on push to main (not PRs)

Closes #1913, #1581

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
Setting push to true unconditionally will cause authentication failures on pull requests since the GHCR login step (line 126 in the full file) only runs when the event is not a pull request. Either the login step should always run, or the push parameter should remain conditional.
```suggestion
          push: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body: The DOCKLE_EXIT environment variable will always be 0 because of the "exit 0" at the end of the step (line 264). The actual exit code from dockle should be captured before the exit 0. Consider capturing it with: DOCKLE_EXIT=$?; echo "DOCKLE_EXIT=$DOCKLE_EXIT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"; exit 0

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The enforcement gate checks if DOCKLE_EXIT is not equal to '0' (as a string comparison), but due to the bug where DOCKLE_EXIT will always be 0, this gate will never trigger. Additionally, ensure that the comparison uses proper syntax - in bash conditionals within GitHub Actions, this should be checking the environment variable properly.
```suggestion
        run: |
          echo "Dockle exit: $DOCKLE_EXIT"
          if [ "${DOCKLE_EXIT}" != "0" ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
```

commits.message:
fix: consolidate Docker workflow for reliable multiplatform builds

- Remove docker-image.yml (single-arch workflow that was overwriting
  multiplatform images with amd64-only builds)
- Modify docker-multiplatform.yml to always build and push platform-specific
  images (amd64, arm64, s390x), even on PRs
- Add Dockle image linting with SARIF upload
- Add SBOM attestation via Cosign alongside image signing
- Only tag as :latest on push to main (not PRs), but always tag with SHA
- Use SHA-based tags for scanning to ensure correct image is analyzed

Closes #1913

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
refactor: extract security scanning to separate workflow

- Create docker-scan.yml for Dockerfile linting and image security scans
- Runs on PRs and pushes, builds locally without pushing to registry
- Includes Hadolint, Dockle, Syft SBOM, Trivy, and Grype scans
- Remove lint and scan jobs from docker-multiplatform.yml
- Multiplatform workflow now focuses on build, manifest, and signing

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
